source_claim_or_motif: A side length T alone defines the cone
technical_boundary: T is paired with a half-angle; h=T cos alpha and R=T sin alpha.

source_claim_or_motif: The source theta+pi wrap alone is a Klein-bottle base quotient
technical_boundary: It is retained as an internal state-bundle half-turn. A reflective theta map is required for the non-orientable base profile.

source_claim_or_motif: Time stops being linear and becomes a loop
technical_boundary: Linear time is retained; phase is time modulo a declared period and winding remains separate lineage.

source_claim_or_motif: 18:55 is an intrinsic physical constant
technical_boundary: It is a profile seed/reference tick with a declared unit.

source_claim_or_motif: Bit shifting directly halves rho and theta
technical_boundary: Appending a trie bit refines one scheduled quantized interval; coordinate values are decoded separately.

source_claim_or_motif: Every branch is chaotic
technical_boundary: A binary branch is deterministic. Chaos requires a specified map and measured sensitivity.

source_claim_or_motif: A missing shackle automatically produces chaos
technical_boundary: Constraint-row deletion changes rank/nullity; dynamics require mass, force and damping models.

source_claim_or_motif: All forces automatically scale by e^-rho
technical_boundary: Coordinate covectors transform by the inverse Jacobian; physical force laws remain separately typed.

source_claim_or_motif: The sweep field is always an exact SDF
technical_boundary: The report provides an exact cone SDF and a certified interval for the sweep infimum; a generic sweep envelope is not automatically an exact SDF.

source_claim_or_motif: One jitter bit contains roughness, sensor noise and full state
technical_boundary: The bit is a bounded deterministic perturbation or selector; residual, error, topology and lineage remain separate.

source_claim_or_motif: The contiguous bit table is the same as Morton interleaving
technical_boundary: Two explicit layouts are supplied and tested independently.

source_claim_or_motif: Pointerless sparse trees have zero metadata
technical_boundary: They avoid explicit child pointers but still require topology/presence and navigation metadata.

source_claim_or_motif: 192-to-64 is an equivalent 3:1 compression
technical_boundary: It is a nominal width ratio unless decode ranges, errors and semantic equivalence are declared.

source_claim_or_motif: A sign bit is equivalent to a float SDF
technical_boundary: It discards magnitude and uncertainty and needs a separate boundary representation.

source_claim_or_motif: A 12-bit word is equivalent to any 4x4 float matrix
technical_boundary: It can only select a versioned finite codebook/state family.

source_claim_or_motif: Eight keys per cache line means eight outcomes per clock
technical_boundary: Capacity does not establish execution width, latency or instruction throughput.

source_claim_or_motif: Log packing stores infinite detail in finite memory
technical_boundary: The declared profile contains exactly 2^64 keys and finite grammar/state budgets.

source_claim_or_motif: All possible movements are universal O(1)
technical_boundary: Only bounded direct lookup after key construction may be constant expected access; generation, collisions, verification and memory remain.

source_claim_or_motif: L-system recursion is infinite in the substrate
technical_boundary: Expansion is finite and rejects depth, symbol or stack overflow.

source_claim_or_motif: Rasterization/raymarching are required
technical_boundary: The 3.6.2 core is purely referential geometry, topology, indexing and event calculus; display remains downstream.
